description: This Java source file defines the ConnectionValidator class, which validates network connections based on their type within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It checks connection addresses, acknowledgement labels, payload mapping limits, SSL certificate configurations, and delegates protocol-specific validation to supplied validator instances.

classes.name: ConnectionValidator
classes.description: A final class responsible for validating connections within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It validates addresses, acknowledgements, payload mappings, SSL certificates, and protocol-specific aspects of a Connection object based on its configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a ConnectionValidator with specific connection type validators.

methods.name: getAcknowledgementLabelsToDeclare
methods.description: Static method that retrieves the set of acknowledgement labels that need to be declared for a given connection.

methods.name: resolveConnectionIdPlaceholder
methods.description: Static method that resolves placeholders in acknowledgement labels with the actual connection ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a Connection object, checking addresses, acknowledgements, SSL certificates, mapping limits, and delegating to protocol-specific validators.
